label: SIMULATION / HISTORICAL REPLAY — NOT PAID WORK
title: Options ending with three or more hyphens are parsed as positional arguments
issueBody: Option names ending with three or more hyphens are incorrectly placed in the positional array instead of being parsed as options.
acceptance: Parse option names ending with three or more hyphens as options.
Preserve bare hyphen, end-of-options, empty invalid option, and ordinary hyphenated option behavior.
Pass npm test, npm run test:esm, and npm run test:typescript where available.
expectedDeliverable: Resolve the parser defect with focused regression evidence and a professional unpublished PR draft.
antiLeakage: Use only the supplied facts and exact pre-fix source. Do not inspect accepted fixes, post-fix source, current main, or issue timelines and comments.
